title: Isola Hire-an-Agent request body
description: The COMPLETE JSON body of POST /api/isola/tenants/{tenant_id}/hires/. Exactly four properties, all required. Tenant identity is NOT here - it comes from the authenticated session. correlation_id is NOT here - it is server-generated. exposure is NOT here and is prohibited: any client-supplied exposure is rejected 400 even when its value matches the resolved template.

template_id.description: Stable catalogue entry id. Matched exactly against the server-side registry; unknown value is 404.

template_version.description: Immutable version of that entry. Mismatch is 409 and is NEVER coerced to latest.

template_digest.description: Optimistic-integrity assertion: content hash of the resolved template INCLUDING its exposure. Mismatch fails closed with 409 and never silently upgrades to a newer template.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied. Scoped to (tenant, requester, operation). Same key + identical canonical request returns the original result; same key + different request is a deterministic 409.
